fact: The HISWACA-SOP1 audit report dated 28 May 2025 for the period 1 November 2023 to 31 December 2024 lists, among the funded activities of ANSADE's component C1, the operationalisation of mechanisms to exploit administrative sources (health, education, water, environment) and the strengthening of the customs information system SYDONIA, with USD 2.4 million for sectoral and subnational administrative data.
title: Projet d'Harmonisation et d'Amélioration des Statistiques en Afrique de l'Ouest et du Centre (HISWACA-SOP1) - Rapport d'audit des états financiers de la période du 01/11/2023 au 31/12/2024
